Do listopadowego odcinka 2. sezonu fabularnego serialu „Gliniarze Śląsk” realizowanego na śląsku poszukuję aktorów do nastepujących ról:

Nożyk (37) – krępy, dobrze zbudowany bandzior o groźnej aparycji. 
Data: 03.11
Stawka: 600 zł netto

Lassota (39) – krępy, dobrze zbudowany bandzior o groźnej aparycji. – prawo jazdy
Data: 03.11
Stawka: 600 zł netto

Ozimski (37) – przystojny biznesmen, chłodny w obyciu, patrzący na wszystkich z góry. Niemiły, nieprzyjemny w rozmowie. 
Data: 03.11, 05.11 i 06.11
Stawka: 3 tys. zł netto za całość

Zawiślak (41) – wyszczekany prywatny detektyw, modny, przystojny, robiący wokół siebie dużo hałasu 
Data: 03.11, 05.11 i 06.11
Stawka: 2400 zł netoo za całość

Wąsik (26) – przeciętny facet, przeciętna aparycja i sylwetka – prawo jazdy kat. A i B
Data: 03.11 i 05.11
Stawka: 1600 zł netto z acałość

Czernik (42) – biznesmen, zadbany, bogaty, dyrektor prywatnej kliniki chirurgii plastycznej, samotny ojciec 
Data: 03.11
Stawka: 800 zł netto

Chętnych panów zapraszam do wysyłania zgłoszeń na adres: Rita.mascarat@wp.pl

Proszę o zgłoszenia TYLKO mailowe (nie odpowiadam na wiadomości prywatne)

W tytule maila prosze o podanie nazwy postaci.

W treści maila proszę o zawarcie następujących informacji:
1. Wiek/wzrost/waga
2. Nr tel. do kontaktu
3. Linki do sowich materiałów video – demo/wizytówka/scenki castingowe (w przypadku braku, do wybranych osób wyślę materiał ze scenariusza do nagrania)
4. Aktualne zdjęcie
5. Krótki opis doświadczenia
6. Informacje o ukończonych szkołach/kursach/warsztatach aktorskich
7. Informację o posiadanym i czynnym prawie jazdy lub jego braku
8. Miejscowość zamieszkania 

Nie zwracamy kosztów dojazdu/noclegu

CASTING CALL — PICTURE PERFECT 
Independent Romantic Drama | Non-Union | Potential festival submission. 

A successful photographer dreams of building a family. A driven executive has built her life around independence. When they fall in love, their fears threaten the future they could share.

Filming in Chicago, Illinois
Projected filming: Early spring 2027
Leads: $400/day | Supporting: $300/day | Day-player $250/day
Travel and lodging covered
Submit by December 1, 2026

LEAD ROLES

ISAIAH —  African American Male, must portray ages 30–40.
A successful photographer with warmth, natural charm, and a deep desire for lasting love. Requires romantic chemistry and emotional range.

NAOMI — African American Female, must portray ages 30–40.
An accomplished executive whose professional confidence conceals a fear of emotional dependence. Requires strength, vulnerability, and natural romantic chemistry.

SUPPORTING ROLES
Ages listed are playing ranges.

• ROBERT — African American Male, late 50s–60s. Isaiah’s affectionate, quietly humorous father. A widower with a rich inner life and a powerful emotional scene.

• VIVIAN — African American Female, late 50s–60s. Naomi’s polished, protective mother, rediscovering herself after an unhappy marriage.

• LEAH — African American Female, late 20s–early 30s. A sweet, personable grocery-store employee with a shy, playful side.

• MONICA — African American Female, late 20s–mid 30s. Seeking answers after being ghosted. A small role requiring emotional depth and believable vulnerability.

• TASHA — African American Female, late 20s–early 30s. Bold, flirtatious, and playful.

• ALICIA — Latina  Female, early–mid 30s. Navigating a complicated breakup, with warmth and vulnerability beneath her frustration.

• MAYA — Female, adult. Isaiah’s capable studio assistant. Observant, supportive, and naturally funny.

• ELLIS — Adult, any gender. Naomi’s efficient assistant. Professional presence with understated humor.

INTIMACY NOTES
Lead roles involve kissing and implied intimacy. Supporting roles involving intimacy require implied intimacy only—no kissing. Requirements will be discussed before casting.

TO SUBMIT
picperfect2027@gmail.com

Subject: PICTURE PERFECT — [ROLE] — [YOUR NAME]

Include:

• Headshot and recent photo
• Acting résumé
• Reel or performance clip, if available
• Current city and contact information
• Spring 2027 availability
• Role(s) you’re submitting for

Additional background and brief speaking opportunities will be announced separately.

Share with an actor who would be a great fit!

#PicturePerfectFilm #CastingCall #ChicagoActors #ActorsWanted #PaidCasting #IndependentFilm #NonUnion

Male actors wanted for The Crucible this coming February. Rehearsals start November 1
Calling all mature male actors in Ottawa-Gatineau. 

Rehearsals will be Sundays 1-5 and Wednesdays 6-8:30 with a break from December 16 to January 6.

We're urgently looking for a few more male actors to fill supporting and smaller roles in our community theatre production of Arthur Miller's The Crucible. 

We're looking for enthusiastic performers who enjoy bringing interesting characters to life. 

We have a large group of actors already to go. We just want to fill in these parts strongly. 

Auditions, please reach out ASAP. 

We are holding callbacks tonight, Thursday, October twenty-second, and would welcome interested actors who are available to join us. 

Can't make it tonight? 

No problem. 

We're also accepting video auditions. Video audition deadline, Friday, October 30.

If you're interested, please send me a private message as soon as possible and I'll provide the details. 

Please share this post with anyone you think might be interested. Natalie Fraser, director, The Crucible.

Connect@nataliefraser.ca

sharedPost.text:
"নারদের বাক্য শুনি কহেন হরিপ্রিয়া।
নারীর দুখের কারণ শুন মন দিয়া।। 
নারীর পরম গতি স্বামী ভিন্ন কেবা।
ভুলেও না করে নারী পতি পদসেবা।।
এয়োতির চিহ্ন সিঁদুর শাঁখা নাহি পরে।
ধর্মগ্রন্থ নাহি ছোঁয় উপন্যাস পড়ে।।
উচ্চহাসি উচ্চকথা সর্বদা কয়। 
মস্তকেতে ঘোমটা তার কখনো না রয়।। 
ছড়া নাহি দেয় দোরে বিহানের কালে।
সন্ধ্যায় ধূপ দীপ ঘরে নাহি জ্বালে।। 
লজ্জা সঙ্কোচ সবই দিয়া বিসর্জন। 
যথা তথা স্বেচ্ছায় করয়ে ভ্রমণ।। 
এহেন অলক্ষ্মী নারী জগতের দুখ। 
রমণীর গুণে বাড়ে সংসারে সুখ।।"

লক্ষীর পাঁচালির 'লক্ষী মেয়ে'র একেবারে বিপরীত মেরুতে দাঁড়িয়েছিলেন হটী বিদ্যালংকার। সেই 'হটীর সন্ধানে' আমি তোলপাড় করছি কল্লোলিনী কলকাতা। আজ, 'শারদ পূর্ণিমা নিশি'তে ক্যালকাটা মেডিক্যাল রিসার্চ ইনস্টিটিউটের ক্রিটিকাল কেয়ার ইউনিটের মেডিসিনের ডক্টর, অভিনেতা, নির্দেশক শ্রীমতী ইন্দুদীপা 'হটী' সিনহার সম্মুখে। 

পিতৃতন্ত্র নির্ধারিত যাবতীয় বদগুণসমন্বিতা অলক্ষীদের আজ জয় হোক। কারণ, সময় যখন ঘুমায়, তখন কোজাগরী হয়ে থাকেন অলক্ষীরাই। 

#rakeshghoshplaywright #rakeshhghosh #bengalitheatre #hotividyalankar #femaleempowermentmovement #femaledoctors

.   🎭 OUVERTURE AUDITIONS SAISON 7 🎭
             Troupe amateur avec adhésion 
                  DONC NON RÉMUNÉRÉ 

➡️Auditions lundi 02/11 ou lundi 9/11/26 de 19h15 à 21h15 Lyon 2
( 15 min de passage avec 1 page de dialogues et 1 comédien qui vous donnera la réplique )

INFOS : https://www.lespendrillonsrouges.fr/page/4142138-auditions-2026-27
_____________________________________________

🎭 Pour sa prochaine comédie, la troupe de théâtre Lyonnaise Troupe Les Pendrillons Rouges recherche 4 comédiens :

                     " TOI TOI, MON TOIT "
                  Écriture & Mise en scène 
    Nicolas Bret-Morel & Rébecca Lisa Mantel 
 
SYNOPSIS :
2 appartements se font face, 2 univers qui s'opposent / 1 locataire aveugle et 1 propriétaire femme d'affaire.
La famille de Fabienne, famille style Tuche, part en vacances aujourd'hui avec ses enfants mais le loyer n'a pas été payé !
Sa voisine du dessus, Lauranne femme d'affaire, a tout fait pour avoir une image des plus brillante : appartement dernier étage, femme de ménage, baby-sitter ... 
Tout est sous contrôle ou presque ! 1 détail vient ternir ce tableau :
Elle veut récupérer l'appartement du dessous pour construire l'aboutissement de son rêve ultime : un duplex penthouse !
 _____________________________________________
 
➡️ Vous souhaitez intégrer une troupe de théâtre bienveillante qui s'éclate et qui cartonne sur Lyon ? 😊
Vous avez déjà une expérience théâtrale ou pas ? 
Vous souhaitez partager une très belle aventure humaine avec nous ?

Parfait ! C'est que cette annonce est faite pour vous mais seulement si vous faites preuve d'écoute, de bienveillance, de respect et de bonne humeur 🤗
 
➡️ Ne pas avoir peur ou être allergique aux chiens car cette année, une chienne guide d'aveugles sera avec nous tous les lundis et sur scène aussi.
Nous jouerons cette année pour l' Association de Chiens Guides d'Aveugles de Lyon et du Centre Est 
 _____________________________________________

PERSONNAGES RECHERCHES
 
👩 CYNTHIA : 
      Comédienne âge apparent 25 à 35 ans. 
      Rôle d'une baby-sitter très dynamique et un
      peu "simplette/naïve" parfois à côté de la
      plaque.
 
🙍AUREA : 
     Comédienne âge apparent 35 à 55 ans.
     Femme de ménage rock'n'roll. Personnalité
     haut en couleur et n'a pas sa langue dans sa
     poche !
 
🦰THIMOTHEE : 
     Comédien âge apparent 35 à 50 ans.
     Marié avec Sonia qu'il adore mais il a du
     mal avec son humour. Il se laisse mener par
     le bout du nez par sa femme.
 
🙍SONIA : 
     Comédienne âge apparent 35 à 50 ans.
     Femme de Thimothée. C'est une rigolote
     bourrue, un aplomb à tout épreuve,
     envahissante et qui ne manque pas de faire
    des blagues même si parfois ça tombe à
    plat. Forte personnalité et grosse énergie.
 _____________________________________________
 
⚠️ Répétitions OBLIGATOIRES salle Bayard tous les lundis à partir du 16/11/26 de 19h à 22h au 32bis cours Bayard 69002 Lyon, sauf vacances scolaires et jours fériés
 
🗓 La GÉNÉRALE le mercredi 22/06/27 de 10h à 17h
🗓 Représentations les 25, 26 et 27 juin 2027 à l' Acte 2 Théâtre  Lyon 9 
🗓 2 journées de répétitions générales à prévoir le dimanche 4 avril et samedi 04 juin 2027 au TH Métro Thmétro Ateliers  69002 Lyon
💰Adhésion annuelle de 250 €
_____________________________________________

POUR POSTULER :

📧 lespendrillonsrouges@gmail.com
👤 Nicolas BRET-MOREL : Président et metteur en scène 
📲 0786364953

Always loved playing fiddle 🎻 to his famous song “Seminole Wind”. I played it a couple of times with Daniel T. Coates, who always has a great way of explaining the history of the Seminole tribe. I recorded the song more than three decades ago with the band “Country Lee” with Mathias Roska as the leadsinger.
#mathiasroska #danieltcoates

items.text:
You watch your self-tape back and think: “That’s not what I meant to do.”

You understood the scene. You felt connected to it. But on camera, the performance looks flat, forced or completely different from what you intended.

And when nobody gives you feedback, how are you supposed to know what to change?

In this FREE live Acting Masterclass, Michael Keogh (Peaky Blinders, Casualty, Marvel’s Secret Invasion) will show you what makes a performance connect on camera, why overthinking can flatten a scene, and how to create emotion without forcing it.

Sunday November 1st at 6pm UK time / 2pm ET

Attend live and receive a FREE bonus valued at $97.

RSVP NOW at the following link:

items.text:
Hello Actors!

We are in search of men for an upcoming Dickens themed immersive market we are producing in Central London. 

All our female roles are cast but we're a bit low on men. 

The market involves improv actors playing characters from Dickens novels such as Fagin and Joe Gargery. You'd be interacting with the public as they try to solve a mystery. 

Dates 23-28th November 

Location: Central London (outdoors)

Fee: £1000 all inclusive

if you don't have casting callback please email caspian@unusualservice.co.uk with the subject line ACTOR - Dickens Market

The Templar | Knights Templar Historical Short Film | Official Update
⚔️ THE TEMPLAR – A Medieval Historical Short Film
Set in the early 14th century, The Templar follows a Knight Templar forced to flee as orders are issued for the arrest of the legendary Knights Templar.
Set against the backdrop of one of the most dramatic periods in medieval history, the film explores survival, loyalty and the fate of a knight whose entire world is falling apart.
Written and directed by Vinnie Camilleri, and starring Espen Hatleskog, The Templar is an independent historical short film being produced in England.
In this latest production update, Espen shares news about the upcoming November shoot, the atmospheric locations and the dark, cinematic look we’re aiming to achieve.
With an original soundtrack in development and preparations moving forward, we’re excited to bring this story to life.
🎬 Follow the journey and support our independent film.

Discover more about the film, the cast, the production and how you can help support the project.��❤️ The Templar is dedicated to the memory of Ant “Butch” Butcher, who was due to appear in the film but sadly passed away before filming began. Although he never got the chance to bring his character to life, he will always be part of this production.��Link is on our Templar IG page

#TheTemplar
#knightstemplar #ShortFilm
#Medieval #EspenHatleskog

🎬 **BOOM OPERATOR WANTED – THE TEMPLAR | INDEPENDENT SHORT FILM**

We're looking for a **boom operator with some previous experience** to join us on our upcoming independent short film, *The Templar*.

📍 **Location:** Wirral / Merseyside
📅 **Filming Dates:** Friday 27th – Monday 30th November 2026

*The Templar* is a passion project being brought to life by a dedicated cast and crew, all of whom are generously giving their time on a voluntary basis.

The production budget has been invested in essential filming equipment, period costumes, props and other production requirements, meaning we're unable to offer payment for this role.

The film is also intended as a **proof of concept**. Our aim is to explore its potential, and if successful, we'd love to develop *The Templar* into a full series.

We're hoping to find someone who shares our enthusiasm for independent filmmaking and would enjoy being part of the project while gaining further on-set experience and an additional film credit.

**Some previous practical experience in boom operation or location sound recording is essential**, although we're not expecting someone with years of professional experience.

🎙️ **Sound equipment provided:**
* Boom pole with blimp windshield
* RØDE NTG3 shotgun microphone
* Zoom F6 field recorder

All the necessary sound equipment is available, although you're welcome to bring your own equipment if preferred.

We're looking for someone reliable, enthusiastic and comfortable working as part of a small, committed film crew.

🎥 **Find out more about the film:**
[https://vinniecamilleri.com/thetemplar/](https://vinniecamilleri.com/thetemplar/)

📧 **Interested or have any questions?**
Please email [info@vinniecamilleri.com](mailto:info@vinniecamilleri.com)

Please feel free to share this post with anyone who might be interested.

**The Templar – An Independent Film with Bigger Ambitions.**

URGENT CASTING CALL | THE NEST PROJECT

MALE AND FEMALE ACTORS REQUIRED

We are urgently seeking two talented actors to join the cast of The Nest Project, an independent feature film currently approaching the final stages of production.

ROLES AVAILABLE 

Male Actor: To portray a complex, pessimistic and confrontational character with controlling, narcissistic and short-tempered tendencies. We are seeking someone capable of delivering a convincing and emotionally engaging performance.

Female Actor: To portray a mother in a supporting role.

FILMING DETAILS

Dates: Friday 30th and Saturday 31st October 2026
Location: Chester, Cheshire
Availability: Applicants must be available on both dates.

Important: We are specifically seeking actors who have not previously filmed on this production.

ABOUT THE PRODUCTION

The Nest Project is an independent passion project. This is an unpaid production with all cast and crew generously contributing their time and talent.

Successful applicants will receive an IMDb credit, valuable on-set experience and the opportunity to establish industry connections.

Following completion and post-production, we intend to submit the film to the Cannes Film Festival. 

We also have seven further film projects planned, with potential paid opportunities for cast and crew in future productions.

HOW TO APPLY - URGENT

Interested applicants should email their headshot or Spotlight profile, a brief summary of acting experience and confirmation of availability for both filming dates.

Email: info@majesticacademyofperformingarts.co.uk

We welcome applications from committed, professional and reliable actors who are enthusiastic about joining our production.

Casting by Majestic Talent Agency / Majestic Academy of Performing Arts

Please share this opportunity with any suitable actors.

CASTING LONG MÉTRAGE – « UNE FLEUR SANS NOM » – Inspiré d'une histoire vraie – Région parisienne

Il lui a envoyé des roses. Sans carte. Sans nom.
Il savait parler devant des salles entières, mais pas dire trois mots à une seule personne.

« Une fleur sans nom » est un long métrage indépendant d'environ 95 minutes, adapté du livre du même nom et inspiré d'une histoire vraie. Une histoire d'amour, de silence et de foi, racontée par deux voix : celle d'un jeune homme de 19 ans, et celle de la rose qu'il a envoyée.

Le film est produit par l'association culturelle All With Heart, avec une ambition claire : le cinéma.

NOUS RECHERCHONS

Rôle principal
• LINA, 18-22 ans. Lumineuse, sensible, pleine d'humour. Elle reçoit les roses et cherche le visage qui se cache derrière. Un regard qui dit tout.

Rôles secondaires
• NADIA, 40-50 ans. La mère de Farès. Discrète, elle voit tout sans rien dire.
• YANIS, 18-23 ans. Le meilleur ami de Farès, le comique de la bande. Le sens du rythme est indispensable.
• ILYES, 18-23 ans. L'autre ami, calme et profond, celui à qui l'on se confie.
• CLAIRE, 42-52 ans. La mère de Lina, sa confidente.
• KARIM, 45-55 ans. Le père de Lina. Protecteur, et maladroit quand il mène sa propre enquête sur les roses.
• NOAM, 16 ans à l'écran (rôle réservé à un comédien majeur). Le petit frère de Lina, malin, le premier à soupçonner Farès.

• De nombreux figurants, notamment pour la troupe d'une comédie musicale. Chant ou danse bienvenus.

LE PROJET
• Tournage majoritairement en région parisienne.
• Projet associatif non rémunéré. Chaque participant signe une convention de bénévolat et une autorisation d'exploitation de son image et de son interprétation.
• Ce que tu reçois : un rôle dans un long métrage pensé pour le cinéma, ton nom au générique, les images de tes scènes pour ta bande démo, une invitation à l'avant-première, et une équipe exigeante et bienveillante.

Pendant des semaines, il a envoyé des fleurs sans nom. Cette fois, nous signons.
Une fleur sans nom. Rien de ce qui est beau n'attend.

items.summary:
CASTING LONG MÉTRAGE – « UNE FLEUR SANS NOM » – Inspiré d'une histoire vraie – Région parisienne

Il lui a envoyé des roses. Sans carte. Sans nom.
Il savait parler devant des salles entières, mais pas dire trois mots à une seule personne.

« Une fleur sans nom » est un long métrage indépendant d'environ 95 minutes, adapté du livre du même nom et inspiré d'une histoire vraie. Une histoire d'amour, de silence et de foi, racontée par deux voix : celle d'un jeune homme de 19 ans, et celle de la rose qu'il a envoyée.

Le film est produit par l'association culturelle All With Heart, avec une ambition claire : le cinéma.

CASTING CALL OUT!! PLEASE SHARE!!

We’re looking for a male actor aged 40-60 to play a quirky, Italian detective for an upcoming restaurant campaign shooting in London.

Think 80s detective, thick moustache, trench coat, big personality and brilliant comedic timing!

We’re looking for someone with strong facial expressions who can switch between serious and comedic acting.

An Italian accent (Neapolitan or Sicilian) would be a bonus but isn’t essential.

No acting experience necessary. We welcome aspiring actors and people with interesting personalities!

LOCATION: London

DEADLINE: Thursday 22 October, 6PM

To apply, please email bardhacasting@gmail.com with your name, age, location, Instagram profile and recent photos.

Please share with anyone you think would be perfect for this role!

items.text:
CASTING CALL — AM I BEAUTIFUL?
Independent Supernatural Horror Feature

Some questions should never be answered.

When an antique mirror connects a university classroom to a disturbing Japanese legend, a cultural anthropology professor searches for answers as people around her begin dying.

ROLES AVAILABLE
Ages listed are playing ages.

MAYA BENNETT — Woman, 35–45
An intelligent, compassionate anthropology professor whose determination to protect her students becomes an obsession.

AIKO MORITA / THE WOMAN — Japanese woman, 28–40
A tragic woman behind a terrifying supernatural presence. Requires emotional range, expressive eyes, and strong physical storytelling. Prosthetic makeup and choreographed violence involved.

LENA ORTIZ — Woman, 20–25
A perceptive, outspoken student whose confidence is tested by grief and escalating supernatural encounters.

EMI SATO — Japanese woman, 35–50
A warm, practical language lecturer and Maya’s close friend. Dryly funny and fiercely dependable.

NICOLE BENNETT — Woman, 38–48
Maya’s loving, direct sister, struggling to keep her connected to her family.

OWEN PRICE — Man, 20–25
A charming, sarcastic student whose ordinary night becomes a terrifying fight for survival.

MARCUS REED — Man, 21–26
Owen’s easygoing close friend. Requires humor, emotional vulnerability, and intense fear.

TESSA — Woman, 20–25
A curious student who shares fragments of a disturbing legend before its consequences become personal.

DANIEL HART — Man, 40–50
A meticulous, quietly humorous university collections manager. Includes a sustained physical horror sequence.

LUIS VEGA — Man, 45–60
An experienced campus security officer with dry humor and a strong protective instinct.

NOAH WELLS — Man, 21–27
A student and campus employee caught in a terrifying encounter after his shift. Requires physical suspense and simulated injury effects.

CALEB TURNER — Man, 20–26
A student working at the recreation center whose closing routine becomes a fight for survival.

KENJI — Japanese man, 30–45
Aiko’s jealous, controlling husband. Requires restrained menace and choreographed dramatic violence.

YUMI — Japanese woman, 23–33
Aiko’s affectionate younger sister. Requires warmth, underlying concern, and a powerful grief reaction.

NAOKO — Japanese woman, 60–75
A dignified, direct woman determined to protect the truth about her family’s history.

DETECTIVE ALVAREZ — Man, 35–55
A calm, compassionate investigator who remains skeptical of extraordinary explanations.

DEPARTMENT CHAIR — Woman, 45–65
An authoritative university administrator balancing professional responsibilities with concern for her colleagues and students.

JESS — Woman, 20–25
Lena’s caring, practical roommate. Requires natural dialogue and believable friendship chemistry.

PRODUCTION DETAILS

Location: TBD — Houston, TX or Atlanta, GA
Projected filming: Spring 2027
Non-union
Lead roles: $400/day
Supporting roles: $300/day
Submission deadline: December 1, 2026

Seeking a diverse cast. All performers must be 18 or older. Roles without a specified ethnicity are open to all ethnicities.

Japanese-speaking ability is a plus, but NOT a requirement. Select roles include Japanese dialogue.

This film includes supernatural horror, simulated blood, prosthetic makeup, and choreographed violence. Certain roles involve domestic violence and suicide themes. Role-specific requirements will be discussed during casting.

TO SUBMIT

Email amibeautiful2027@gmail.com with:

• Name and role(s) of interest
• Current headshot
• Acting résumé or experience summary
• Reel or acting sample, if available
• Home city and spring 2027 availability
• Ability to work in Houston, Atlanta, or either location
• Japanese-language proficiency, if applicable

Subject line: AM I BEAUTIFUL? — [ROLE] — [ACTOR NAME]

Share with an actor who would be a great fit!

#CastingCall #AmIBeautiful #HorrorFilm #IndieFilm #HoustonActors #AtlantaActors #ActorsWanted

items.text:
Casting Call for Upcoming Dark-Comedy Musical 'Psychopomp!'

Been talking to some awesome people about a few roles in this show from my recent posts, and will be making final decisions fairly soon here! If you're interested in auditioning, or hearing more about any of the main or supporting roles, feel free to shoot us an email - thanks, all! 

Overview:

Psychopomp! is a new dark-comedy stage musical about the insane lengths that a couple will go to be together. The play is packed with infectious rock and roll, raucous comedy, and bombastic characters - think Beetlejuice meets Alice Cooper. The word 'Psychopomp' refers to the being that brings one's spirit into the afterlife, like Anubis, the Valkyries, Charon on the River Styx, or The Grim Reaper. As the settings and humor of the show dissolve into madness, the play morphs from Romeo and Juliet, to Rocky Horror, to The Addams Family, on an irreverent ride through the afterlife.

General Info:

Performance Location: Upstairs at El Centro in Hollywood, CA

Performance Dates: February 26th, 27th, and 28th (evenings)

Rehearsal Location: TBD dependent upon cast-member locations (first few rehearsals likely in San Fernando)

Rehearsal Dates: Starting Winter of 2026/2027 – time TBD

Union Affiliation: Non-union

Contact info: Justin - psychopomprocks@gmail.com

Compensation: Dependent on role – profits from the show will be paid to cast. On longer rehearsal nights, meals will be provided. The show will be filmed and photographed, and a cast album will be recorded – all available for you to use however you like.

Requested Audition Materials:

-Self tape of a scene/monologue and/or video of previous stage or film work

-Self tape or live video of vocal music performance – rock/pop preferred

ROLES:

TESS – Female - 25-38

Fun, sarcastic punk rock guitarist – Confident, but doesn't take herself too seriously. Guitar experience a plus, but not at all required.

VIKKI – Female - 25-38

Tess' friend – think Rizzo from Grease. Sassy but protective of Tess. And sometimes a little annoyed by her, too.

JAKE – Male - 25-38

Sincere, self-effacing, sorta nerdy - aspiring magician.

LUKE – Male - 25-38

Jake's friend – laid-back, smooth, funny, etc - Cooler than Jake, but that's a low bar.

GUITARIST and DRUMMER – Male/Female – no age requirement

The actual live musicians for the show – upstage throughout show.

GRIM REAPER – Male/Female – no age requirement

The Psychopomp. Tess' sidekick throught the play. Not overly ambitious about their career.

PSYCHIC – Male/Female – no age requirement

Charlatan in a world where all the weird, wild mythology turns out to be real.

MAD SCIENTIST – Male/Female – no age requirement

Beach-bum parrot-head scientist – eccentric but earnest.

OTHER ONE-SCENE ROLES:

COP, BARTENDER, BAND SINGER, CAPTAIN HOOK, CRUELLA DE VIL, CHARLIE CHAPLIN, HELL RECEPTIONIST, HERCULES, 007, AWARD SHOW HOST, HEAVEN SHOWRUNNER – Male/Female based on the character – no age requirement.

NOTE: For most of these roles, the actor will play multiple roles (for example, the person playing VIKKI could also play the CRUELLA).

Feel free to send an email with any questions on the audition process, or any other info you would like!

If you would like to audition for a specific singing role, let me know, and I can send you demos of that character's songs.

Thanks, all! Looking forward to hearing from you!

Is your acting alive ! or feeling a bit undead?

We had a very much alive class online today with my international spontaneous scene study class today at 1130 am.  We meet Mondays and Weds.

Today we had great work from Logan Taylor Emmanuel Ale Priya Vardhana and Pushty Suri - representing NYC, Manchester, UK, and New Delhi and Dubai, India.

If your interested in the marriage of improvisation and text work. DM me.

Check out Seth Michael May Studio
And my instagram @sethmichaelmaystudios for a deeper dive into this way of working.

🚢 CASTING | CRUISE SHIP CONTRACT 🎤💃🕺
We are looking for professional MALE & FEMALE SINGERS WITH DANCING ABILITIES for an upcoming cruise ship contract!

📅 Contract Period:
Rehearsals (Germany):
• April 3, 2027 – May 16, 2027

First Contract:
• May 16, 2027 – October 18, 2027

Scheduled Break:
Approximately 1 month

Second Contract:
• November 17, 2027 – June 20, 2028

This is a long-term engagement consisting of two contracts with a scheduled break in between. Dates are subject to final confirmation.

💰Salary & Agency Commission:

• Monthly salary on board: €3,000–€3,300
• 10% agency commission will be deducted from the monthly salary.

Final salary and contract conditions are subject to confirmation.

✨ Requirements:
• Strong professional solo vocal abilities
• Experience in Rock, Pop & Musical Theatre
• Good dancing and movement skills
• Professional stage experience
• Versatility and strong stage presence
• Ability to work in an international cast

📩 How to apply:
Please send your application 
ONLY by email to:
📧 kopentertainmentagency@gmail.com

❗️ Email must include:
1️⃣ Updated CV (PDF) with portrait photo
2️⃣ Height & weight
3️⃣ Professional vocal showreel / singing videos (YouTube or Vimeo)
4️⃣ Dance showreel or movement video (if available)

⚠️ Please apply only if you are available for the full contract period.

If this opportunity is not for you, please share it with other professional singers who might be interested! 🙏

📲 WANT MORE CASTING OPPORTUNITIES?

Join our official Telegram group for upcoming audition🌍

👉 https://t.me/kopentertainmentagency

See you on board! 🚢✨

It’s a casting call!
Paid Shoot in Birmingham

Dates: 07/11/26-19/11/26

Dear Actors, 

I’m looking for Punjabi Speaking Male & Female actors for an upcoming Punjabi film starring on 7th November until the 19th November. 

The dates aren’t locked for the characters yet, it will be preferable if applicants are flexible on the above mentioned dates. 

Screen Age for both male and female: 45-50 yrs old

Also I’m looking for 1 male and 1 female actor in the age range 22-26 yrs. 

Kindly reach out and DM me for more info. 

*Only serious applicants please and flexible on dates* 

Many thanks

Anusri Jain

AIJ Production Limited

topComments.text: I'm not saying you are Bollywood, but my experience is they take months and months to pay you IF they do! I am still out of pocket for a shoot I did for a company 2 years ago, email after email, all ignored. Apologies IF you ligit!

**ŚLĄSK I OKOLICE...**

Do 2 sezonu **GLINIARZE ŚLĄSK, odcinek "muzyczny":)** szukam:

**Roman Hoffman (42)**–gitarzysta bluesowy, w 1 scenie gra na gitarze. Długie włosy. Charyzmatyczny romantyk, trudny w relacjach biznesowych. Dawniej zmagał się z narkotykami. 

**nagranie 3 i 6.11**

**stawka 600 zł za dzień**

**Jan Chodakowski „Jim” (25)**–Inteligentny, cyniczny, mściwy. Pracuje jako barman. Ubiera się w granatowe jeansy, czarny T-shirt, czarny-sweter i czarną kurtkę.

**nagranie 3 i 6.11**

**stawka 800 zł za dzień**

**Gosia Zduńczyk (18) –**tegoroczna maturzystka, córka Marka Zduńczyka. Zafascynowana Hoffmanem. Impulsywna romantyczka i buntowniczka. Ubiera się jeansy, bluzki, sweter, płaszcz.Drobna blondynka.

**nagranie 3.11**

**stawka 800 zł**

**Marek Zduńczyk (45)**– prawnik. Pewny siebie, stanowczy, porywczy i nadopiekuńczy. Sprawia wrażenie człowieka przyzwyczajonego do kontroli. Zadbany, ubrany elegancko lub w stylu smart casual.** prawo jazdy**

**nagranie 3 i 7.11**

**stawka 700 zł za dzień**

**Barmanka (27)**– pracownica bluesowego pubu. Bezpośrednia, spostrzegawcza i obyta z klientami. Atrakcyjna, swobodna, ubrana odpowiednio do pracy za barem.

**nagranie 6.11**

**stawka 600 zł**

**Iza Styczyńska „Izzy” (40) –**była basistka.Twarda, konkretna, niezależna i nieufna. Zadbana, wysportowana, o wyrazistym rockowym stylu.** prawo jazdy**

**nagranie 5 i 6.11**

**stawka 800 zł za dzień**

**Tomasz Napiórowski „Napiór” (39)**–diler narkotyków. Cwaniacki, bezczelny, pewny siebie i obyty z policją. Dobra sylwetka, wygląd człowieka z półświatka. Ubiera się wygodnie, ale modnie.

**nagranie 5.11**

**stawka 800 zł**

**Krzysztof Adamski (39) –**znany wokalista. Charyzmatyczny, pewny siebie, dumny. Zadbany, ubrany w stylu boho.

**nagranie 3.11**

**stawka 600 zł, 1 scena**

Zainteresowane osoby proszę o zgłoszenie na email **obsadaolga@gmail.com**

Zgłoszenie musi zawierać imię, nazwisko, wiek, nr telefonu, aktualne zdjęcie demo lub wizytówkę.

W tytule proszę wpisać wybraną postać.

Do listopadowego odcinka 2. sezonu fabularnego serialu „Gliniarze Śląsk” realizowanego na śląsku poszukuję aktorów do nastepujących ról:

Tokarska (44) – dyrektorka szkoły językowej, elegancka, konkretna, rzeczowa 
Data: 03.11
Stawka: 800 zł netto

Nika (21) – bardzo ładna dziewczyna, zgrabna, dziewczyna gangstera 
Data: 04.11
Stawka: 600 zł netto

Wąsikowa (24) – przeciętna kobieta, młoda matka, zaniedbana
Data: 05.11
Stawka: 600 zł netto

Nożyk (37) – krępy, dobrze zbudowany bandzior o groźnej aparycji. 
Data: 03.11
Stawka: 600 zł netto

Lassota (39) – krępy, dobrze zbudowany bandzior o groźnej aparycji. – prawo jazdy
Data: 03.11
Stawka: 600 zł netto

Wąsik (26) – przeciętny facet, przeciętna aparycja i sylwetka – prawo jazdy kat. A i B
Data: 03.11 i 05.11
Stawka: 1600 zł netto z acałość

Czernik (42) – biznesmen, zadbany, bogaty, dyrektor prywatnej kliniki chirurgii plastycznej, samotny ojciec 
Data: 03.11
Stawka: 800 zł netto

Chętnych aktorów zapraszam do wysyłania zgłoszeń na adres: Rita.mascarat@wp.pl

Proszę o zgłoszenia TYLKO mailowe (nie odpowiadam na wiadomości prywatne)

W tytule maila prosze o podanie nazwy postaci.

W treści maila proszę o zawarcie następujących informacji:
1. Wiek/wzrost/waga
2. Nr tel. do kontaktu
3. Linki do sowich materiałów video – demo/wizytówka/scenki castingowe (w przypadku braku, do wybranych osób wyślę materiał ze scenariusza do nagrania)
4. Aktualne zdjęcie
5. Krótki opis doświadczenia
6. Informacje o ukończonych szkołach/kursach/warsztatach aktorskich
7. Informację o posiadanym i czynnym prawie jazdy lub jego braku
8. Miejscowość zamieszkania
9. Data lub odcinek grania w pierwszym sezonie Gliniarzy Śląsk

Nie zwracamy kosztów dojazdu/noclegu

​
You start with the foundations: anatomy, ergonomics, body mechanics, and how to use your own body well while working — essential for a long and sustainable career in massage.
​
Then the practical work builds month by month, from your first 30-minute sequence to a complete 90-minute massage.
​
The aim is not simply to memorise a sequence, but to understand what you’re doing well enough that the movements become familiar, precise, and adaptable to different bodies.
​

**CASTING CALL – MELBOURNE | THE ONES WHO STAY**

We’re currently casting two supporting roles for our independent Australian feature film, *The Ones Who Stay. *I have co-written and will be co-directing this project, we are searching for talented actors to bring our vision to life.

***PAID ROLE!***

**BEN’S MOTHER - **Female, playing age 42–55 (open to younger submissions)
A loving but formidable mother whose devotion to her son is complicated by fear of abandonment, guilt and a need to remain needed. Approx. 1–3 shoot days (subject to change)

**DR IDA FALKENBERG - **Female, playing age early 50-60s (open to younger submissions)
A renowned international physicist: elegant, intelligent, charismatic and quietly authoritative. **A European accent is required.** Approx. 2–3 shoot days (subject to change)

Filming in **Melbourne across Dec 2026 – Feb 2027**.

If this is you please message me with your headshot, CV and showreel and we will be in touch.

items.text:
Production Title: THIRTEEN scene breakdown.

NEED SOMEONE TO PLAY THE MOM FOR TMRWS CLASS. URGENT. DM if available

*ISO: Melanie (30-50)

A loving but overwhelmed single mother raising her teenage daughter, Tracy, while trying to maintain her own sobriety and rebuild her life. She works as a hairdresser from home and struggles to balance being a parent, a provider, and someone who wants to be her daughter's friend. As Tracy's behavior becomes increasingly destructive, Melanie must confront how little she understands about what her daughter is experiencing. She is warm, energetic, outspoken, imperfect, and emotionally vulnerable. Beneath her casual, sometimes youthful personality is a woman who desperately wants to protect her daughter but fears losing her connection with her

Union/Non-Union: Non-Union Production Type: LMU SFTV Production | Top 7 U.S. Film School Project Length: Short Scene (Four Minutes) 

Project Format: HD, 4:3 Production Location: LMU 

Communication Arts Building | Westchester Campus Filmmaker Website: dopalvarez.com Director/Producer/Casting Director: Adrian Alvarez 

 Location: LMU Westchester Campus | Howard B. Fitzpatrick Pavilion Building Room 108 

Shooting Location: TBA, Small Apartment Email: aalva104@lion.lmu.edu

# LGBTQ+ SUPPORTERS AND ADVOCATES 
LA BASED 

Right now, we are in pre-production on an intentional dating series called *The Booquet*, running alongside our podcast *3 Letters Deep*. Mainstream media consistently leaves Black, trans, and queer folks out of genuine romance or reduces us to a punchline, so we are producing the real thing ourselves.

We are locking in two specific lanes:
1. Singles who want actual connection. If you are Black, LGBTQ+ (specifically centering trans men and women), and done with the games on dating apps, pull up. We are actively casting intentional people ready for a real dynamic.
2. Filmmakers, editors, and crew. We are actively bringing on collaborators who care about raw, grounded storytelling and want to work on independent productions that center our people.

If you are single and looking, or if you do production work and want to link up on this shoot, drop a comment or hit my DMs directly. If you know someone who fits either lane, tag them below.

Let's talk!

📽️ SZUKAM MICRO EKIPY DO REALIZACJI KRÓTKIEGO FILMU / TEASERU | BARTER
Hej! Tworzę krótki film trwający od 30 sekund do 1 minuty i szukam osób, które chciałyby wspólnie zrealizować mały projekt filmowy. W projekcie występuję w roli producentki i reżyserki.

🎭 **Kogo szukam?**

* 1 aktora oraz 3 aktorki – najważniejsza jest umiejętność wyrażania emocji, ponieważ film będzie bez dialogów.

* 1 operatora / operatorki lub asystenta operatora kamery.

* 1 montażysty / montażystki lub asystenta montażu.

🎥 **Organizacja pracy**

* Forma współpracy: barter – projekt realizowany z myślą o rozwoju i budowaniu portfolio.

* 1 niepełny dzień lub wieczór na dokumentację lokacji oraz omówienie szczegółów w biurze, spotkanie całej ekipy.

* 1 dzień zdjęciowy.

* Termin zdjęć: pierwsza połowa listopada.

* Lokacja: kawiarnia oraz ulica przed nią, Warszawa.

🎞️ **Treść**

* Dorastanie chłopaka w mężczyznę poprzez komiczną tragiczną sytuację w relacjach «gen Z» w nasze czasy.

Jeśli jesteś zainteresowany/a, napisz do mnie w wiadomości prywatnej kilka słów o sobie i swoim doświadczeniu (jeśli masz – podeślij portfolio / przykładowe prace).

Będę wdzięczna również za udostępnienie posta osobom, które mogą być zainteresowane! 🤍

Szukamy naszej filmowej babci i przytulnego domu w Warszawie!

W Impact Warsaw przygotowujemy krótki, ciepły i zabawny film w klimacie polskich świąt Bożego Narodzenia.

Szukamy starszej pani, która chciałaby zagrać babcię. Doświadczenie aktorskie nie jest konieczne. Liczą się naturalność, serdeczność i poczucie humoru.

Do zdjęć szukamy również domu lub mieszkania z ciepłym, tradycyjnym wystrojem i dekoracjami świątecznymi. Można zgłosić się do roli lub zaproponować samo miejsce.

Może Wasza mama, babcia lub sąsiadka chciałaby spróbować? Albo znacie odpowiedni dom?

Napiszcie do mnie prywatnie, chętnie opowiem więcej!

We’re looking for our film grandma and a cosy home in Warsaw!

At Impact Warsaw, we’re making a short, warm and funny film celebrating Polish Christmas.

We’re looking for an older woman who would enjoy playing Grandma. Acting experience isn’t essential. Warmth, natural expressions and a sense of humour are what matter.

We’re also looking for a home we could borrow for filming, with traditional character, a warm, cosy interior and Christmas decorations. You can help with either the role or the location.

Perhaps your mum, grandma or neighbour would enjoy being involved? Or you know a suitable home?

Please send me a private message. I’d love to tell you more!

items.text:
🎬 RUHR TAKE – Wir drehen jeden Monat einen Film in 24 Stunden

Hey, kurze Frage in die Runde:

Ich stelle im Ruhrgebiet ein festes kreatives Team zusammen, mit dem wir einmal im Monat innerhalb von 24 Stunden einen kompletten Kurzfilm entwickeln und fertigstellen.

Morgens um 8 Uhr steht nur das Genre fest. Danach entstehen gemeinsam Idee, Drehbuch, Szenenplanung und Produktion – um Mitternacht ist der Film fertig geschnitten. Eine zweite Kamera begleitet den gesamten Prozess mit Behind-the-Scenes-Aufnahmen und Zeitraffern.

Die fertigen Filme und Einblicke in die Produktion veröffentlichen wir auf Instagram, TikTok und YouTube. Auf Instagram sollen die Beiträge nach Möglichkeit als Collab-Posts mit den beteiligten Teammitgliedern erscheinen.

Gesucht werden Menschen für:

• Regie

• Kamera und BTS-Kamera

• Ton und Licht

• Schnitt und Postproduktion

• Social Media

• Schauspiel

Du musst kein Profi sein. Wichtiger sind Zuverlässigkeit, Lust aufs Filmemachen und die Bereitschaft, gemeinsam etwas aufzubauen.

Das Projekt ist aktuell unbezahlt. Dafür erhältst du verwendbares Material für dein Portfolio, Sichtbarkeit über gemeinsame Veröffentlichungen und Zugang zu einem Netzwerk, mit dem auch außerhalb des Formats weitere Projekte entstehen können.

Wenn du Interesse hast, schreib mir bitte kurz:

• welchen Bereich du übernehmen möchtest

• aus welcher Stadt du kommst

• wie deine ungefähre Verfügbarkeit aussieht

• gerne einen Link zu bisherigen Arbeiten – auch ohne Portfolio kannst du dich melden

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/keremdg_/

Das vollständige Konzept:

https://gamma.app/docs/RUHR-TAKE-Ein-Tag-Ein-Film-vatmb9rp27hgijl

Ich freue mich auf kreative Leute, die wirklich Lust haben, gemeinsam Filme zu machen.

Hello, everyone! I’m casting for a surreal indie feature with an “early-cinema” look, with painted faces and vaudevillian/storybookish costumes…the material at turns dark, silly, poetic, musical…basically, “art film”! To get a sense of the style, you can see my work on YouTube at Candy Town Follies, and on TikTok at Candy Town Scandals.

[https://www.youtube.com/@candytownfollies](https://www.youtube.com/@candytownfollies?fbclid=IwZXh0bgNhZW0CMTAAcGRvZgVicmlkETFnSmVQYmFWV3ZUaFdDSndrc3J0YwZhcHBfaWQQMjIyMDM5MTc4ODIwMDg5MgABHuT0F7j6yMzj7LsEZMJp9FDlCxzBcjlVnxHBZIdSVtweOsDJKa2fHLy--lCF_aem_Tf8Vz3XQZnqPSU-ZSU_oBA)

[https://www.tiktok.com/@mrdobbs](https://www.tiktok.com/@mrdobbs?fbclid=IwZXh0bgNhZW0CMTAAcGRvZgVicmlkETFnSmVQYmFWV3ZUaFdDSndrc3J0YwZhcHBfaWQQMjIyMDM5MTc4ODIwMDg5MgABHg_RuObUwINYz7AvpkHwicooWP5bTrGFkyhX9A7QmVMvSHQ8H1hKxMVdVlwc_aem_DeBCO5AwvmmnMMj-7KBpbw)

We're looking to cast a Caucasian boy, between the age of 10 and 13, to play the male lead. We’ll be shooting through to the middle of next year, in Chicago and in Elgin Illinois, with plans to get it out to the film festival circuit by the end of the year. Unfortunately, there’s no pay, as what budget we have will have to be spent on production…but we do feed everyone at the shoots, the film will be listed on IMDB, and all the actors sign contracts which entitle them to a share of the proceeds, if the movie were to make money.

If you’re a stage parent, have a son about that age, and might be interested…please contact me here or at ctfollies@gmail.com …or if you KNOW a stage parent with a son this age, please please please pass this along! Thanks so much!

ROLLENAUSSCHREIBUNG: Frauen und Männer 55–75 für Handy-Aufnahmen zu Hause (Online-Werbung)

Projekt: Werbevideos für FITprofil, eine App mit Band fürs Handgelenk (Berlin)

Gesucht: 3 Personen, Frau oder Mann, 55–75 Jahre, ganz normaler Typ, keine Kamera-Erfahrung nötig

Umfang: Band und App 7 Tage im Alltag nutzen, danach ca. 20 Minuten Aufnahmen mit dem eigenen Handy nach einer einfachen Anleitung. Kein Text zum Auswendiglernen: Gesagt wird nur, was für dich stimmt.

Drehort: bei dir zu Hause (Versand des Bands nach DE, AT oder CH)

Zeitraum: Auswahl bis 30.10., Versand ab 31.10., Aufnahmen bis 12.11.

Gage: 80 € nach Abnahme, dazu das Band zum Behalten und 1 Jahr FITprofil PRO

Verwendung: Online-Werbung (Social Media, Website, App Stores), 24 Monate, schriftliche Vereinbarung vorab. Gesicht und Stimme werden nicht mit KI verändert.

Bewerbung per PN: Alter, Wohnort, ein aktuelles Foto oder ein 10-Sekunden-Video, in dem du dich kurz vorstellst.

Bei uns wird ermittelt, verdächtigt, gelacht und natürlich gut gegessen. Mitten im Publikum, gemeinsam mit einem starken Ensemble.

Du hast Interesse? Dann schreib uns gern ein paar Zeilen über dich – mit Foto und Vita, wenn du magst – an:

info@tatort-dinner.de

Wir freuen uns auf dich!

🎬 CASTING | GŁÓWNA ROLA MĘSKA | WARSZAWA
Poszukujemy aktora do głównej roli w artystycznym filmie krótkometrażowym SOULVNT — Projekt 001 „Kim jesteś?”, łączącym kino, fotografię i fashion editorial.

🎭 O PROJEKCIE

Film opowiada o różnych wersjach ludzkiej tożsamości. Szukamy osoby, która potrafi wyrażać emocje poprzez mimikę, ruch i ekspresję ciała oraz chciałaby zmierzyć się z psychologicznie złożoną rolą.

📍 Lokalizacja: Warszawa

📅 Termin zdjęć: 20–22 listopada 2026 (piątek wieczorem, sobota i niedziela)

🤝 Współpraca: TFP (bez wynagrodzenia finansowego)

🎥 Co oferujemy?

Główną rolę w autorskim filmie krótkometrażowym.

Współpracę z rozbudowaną ekipą kreatywną.

Możliwość pokazania swojego warsztatu aktorskiego.

Profesjonalne materiały filmowe i fotograficzne do portfolio.

🎬 JAK WYGLĄDA CASTING?

Warunkiem udziału jest przygotowanie autorskiego nagrania aktorskiego (30–60 sekund), w którym przedstawisz własną interpretację bohatera na podstawie udostępnionych materiałów.

Same zdjęcia i portfolio nie wystarczą. Nie wymagamy profesjonalnego sprzętu ani montażu - liczą się emocje, ekspresja i kreatywność!

⏰ Deadline przesłania nagrania: piątek, 30 października 2026 r.

📩 JAK SIĘ ZGŁOSIĆ?

Wyślij do mnie wiadomość prywatną z hasłem „KIM JESTEŚ?”.

W odpowiedzi prześlę Ci brief projektu, prezentacje z referencjami wizualnymi oraz szczegóły zadania castingowego.

Zapraszamy do udziału 🖤

items.text:
“Can’t Take You Anywhere” Student Short Comedy Film
When an entitled teenager attends a private business event with his parents, he fails to suppress his awkward and immature nature.

Looking for ￼3 actors for a 5 minute comedy! 

Roles are not paid or promised.

JOHN: Supporting role of the frat-like CEO who helps Thomas (the teenager) make a terrible first impression with a girl seemingly his age. John is overconfident, loud, and raunchy. Looking for a male actor around his 40s.

MOM: Regular mom, mid 40s, who believed her son wouldn’t make a scene and is a supportive as possible for her husband and son.

DAD: Regular dad, also mid 40s, who knew that bringing Thomas was a bad idea. Dad’s goal is to secure a deal with John, the CEO.

We are also looking for plenty of extras for the business party scene.

We will be shooting around the first three weekends of November￼ around Denver, and are fairly flexible as it should be only 1-2 sets. If you are interested or have any questions, you can reach out to me at guinnico@gmail.com or 720-255-2717!

🎬 **PAID CASTING CALL | DENVER, CO**

We're looking for **two adults (ages 50–70)** to portray a married couple in a professional video production for a Denver-based remodeling and construction company.

The video will follow a realistic home remodeling journey, from the initial consultation through design and construction.

**Details:**
* 💰 Pay: $30/hour per person
* 📍 Location: Denver metro area (2 filming locations per day)
* 📅 2–3 filming days (dates TBD)
* 🎥 Simple, natural scenes with little to no dialogue
* No professional acting experience required
* Real couples are encouraged to apply!

We're looking for people who are natural, relatable, comfortable on camera, and reliable enough to commit to all scheduled filming days.

**📋 Interested? Apply here:**

[https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfu2BlwaqINBXdGO8ax86cP0tpswj2flhGP1KloPHXD88E07w/viewform?usp=sharing&ouid=108411361066735844477](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfu2BlwaqINBXdGO8ax86cP0tpswj2flhGP1KloPHXD88E07w/viewform?usp=sharing&ouid=108411361066735844477)

Please complete the application form to be considered. Selected applicants will be contacted with further details.

Feel free to share or tag someone who might be a great fit!

NEU bei Apple & Google Play: Meine Gesangs-App gratis! 📱

Ab sofort gibt es meine Gesangs-App „Sing a Song – Be Happy!“ NEU im App Store und bei Google Play! Darauf habe ich lange hingearbeitet, und ich freue mich riesig, dass sie jetzt endlich für alle zum Herunterladen bereitsteht. 🎉

🎁 Der Anfängerkurs ist komplett GRATIS!
Ob für Frauen oder für Männer: Du kannst deinen Anfängerkurs ganz ohne Kosten ausprobieren. Kein Abo, kein Haken. Einfach App runterladen, anmelden und lossingen! 🎤

In kurzen Videos zeige ich dir Schritt für Schritt, wie du deine Stimme richtig einsetzt – ganz in deinem Tempo, wann und wo du willst.

👉 Jetzt gratis herunterladen:
iPhone: https://apps.apple.com/app/sing-a-song-be-happy/id6787046663
Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=de.singasongbehappy.app
oder über Linktree in meiner Bio

Ich freue mich auf dich! 🎶

#singenlernen #gesangsapp #gesangsunterricht #stimmtraining #singasongbehappy

items.text:
Hello All - My name is Shweta Walia and I am a Co-Producer of an upcoming South Asian Film called "The Ideal". The Ideal is being shot in multiple locations (Reston, Herndon, Ashburn) in Northern Virginia from Thursday, Nov 12th to Sunday Nov15th. We're looking for some Extras to be featured in this short film! Our team is looking for those who are curious about being in a professional film set and can wear traditional South Asian attire on set. It will only take a few hours. Food is provided. If interested, please email treelineproductions1204@gmail.com with the email subject: Interest as [ROLE] Extra - NAME, or DM us @treelineproductions!

Please see flyer for Role details, date and location of shooting.

**About the Film**

The Ideal is a short family drama about two South Asian American brothers who reunite

following the death of their mother. One brother left home to pursue professional success, while

the other stayed behind and became their mother's primary caregiver. Over the course of their

reunion, years of unspoken resentment surrounding family, sacrifice, and success begin to

surface.

🎬 CASTING CALL 🎬
💥 DECEMBER 28, 1835: THE AMBUSH THAT CHANGED FLORIDA FOREVER – CASTING NOW!

​Are you ready to step back in time and bring history to life on the silver screen?

​3 Rats Entertainment is officially casting non-union Actors & Background players for DEFIANCE , a major, ground-breaking historical feature film telling the untold story of Major Francis L. Dade’s command and the powder keg that ignited the Second Seminole War.

​⚠️ WHY THIS STORY MATTERS:

On December 28, 1835, 108 U.S. soldiers marched into the dark Florida pine woods, unaware they were stepping into one of the most ruthless, devastating, and horrifying ambushes in American military history. Trapped in a brutal, desperate fight for survival, nearly the entire command was wiped out in a single morning. 

This isn’t just history, it is a harrowing, raw, and pulse-pounding saga of conflict, courage, and tragedy that changed Florida forever.

​This is Florida’s biggest epic history film, bringing an unforgettable, unvarnished, and deeply important story to the screen for the very first time!

​🔥 ROLES & REQUIREMENTS

​Roles Needed: 

​Major Dade’s U.S. Soldiers

​Actors & Background

​Age Range: Ages 20 – 35 

​Status: Paid (Non-Union)
 ✔️ 
​Target Areas: Florida locals—especially around Tampa Bay, St. Petersburg, Thonotosassa, Ocala, and surrounding communities! 

​Filming Locations: Authentic historic grounds across Florida: 

​📍 Fort King (Ocala)

​📍 Fort Foster (Hillsborough County)

​📍 Boyd Hill Nature Preserve (St. Petersburg)

​📍 Pioneer Museum (Dade City)

​🌟 WHY JOIN THIS PRODUCTION?

​Be part of a story considered the most compelling epic history film that has never been brought to the silver screen.

​Work directly alongside seasoned feature film directors, producers, and dedicated living history specialists.

​Gain invaluable set experience and be part of Florida’s cinematic history.

​📩 HOW TO APPLY ✔️ 

​We are seeking dedicated performers to be part of this legendary project! To submit, please send an email to : 3RatsEntertainment@gmail.com with the following details:

​Attn: Karolina Rybarczyk or Flor Torreance  Casting Directors 

​Photos: 1 clear recent face photo/headshot & 1 full-body photo

​Details: 

​Full Name

​Age (20–35), Height, & Weight

​City of Residence & Contact Info

​A brief note about yourself and any performance experience

​📧 Send your submission today to :  3RatsEntertainment@gmail.com and step onto the set of Florida's premier historic epic film ! 🎬  🎥 

​👉 TAG & SHARE this post with actors, reenactors, and performers in Florida who fit the age range and have what it takes!

items.text:
Paid Casting Call for a Permanent Main Cast Role in my Web Series
Evangaline the Black Mage--Main Character Role-long term, Permanently Position.

Pay Rate:

£15 per hour starting from the first hour when we start filming and ending on the last hour when we have stop filming. Overtime payment is included.

Acting Description:

You'll be following my instructions during each Scene/Take as we film. Showing Body Language, Facial Expressions, and Fighting in a RPG gameplay style. You must have a good memory when saying your lines.

Filming Location(s): 

All over Milton Keynes.

The first 2 locations to start us off filming is The Plough Pub in Simpson, follow by The Crauford Arms Pub in Wolverton.

Sometimes outside of Milton Keynes if I can not find a good filming location within the area. And most times film locations need to be specific in the right film set.

How many days of Filming:

Minimal of 1 day per month. I try and do multiple days per month but it get's hard to arrange and organize a Film Date based around everyone's rota's.

Travel Payment:

Your Travel fee(s) will be covered by me coming and going from Milton Keynes but you will have to show some proof of your journey so I can give the right amount to cover your Travels.

Food and Drinks:

Food and Drinks will be provided by me, but I don't bring food and drinks since the Team has been ok bringing there own. If we are near a Local Shop, Café, Coffee Shop, or even a Fast Food Restaurant, ect. Just let me know what you like and I will pay for you.

Evangaline Character Description: 

Full Name: Evangaline Springbell

Age: 19

Class: Black Mage-(Elemental Spellcaster)

Weapon(s): Fans and Rods-(Maybe)

Character Appearance:

She wears a big Leather Brown Wizard Hat with a big Red Ribbon to the side of the Belt Buckle, a Neck Choker, and a smooth Summer Red and Black Tartan Dress with a thin small Black Jacket.

She has Black Leggings with Red and Black Socks on and her hair colour changes sometimes to match her emotions.

Her alternative clothes is a Red and Black Hell Bunny Dress. (DLC idea I have used in the past.)

Character Bio:

Evangaline is a skilful Black Mage who uses Black Magic Spells that are a variety of Elemental and Destructive Power.

She is strong-willed, courageous, and has a strong sense of determination to punish those who commit evil deeds on others with her Black Magic. Even if they are her allies and friends which makes her quite scary.

At times she losses' her cool and get's angry sometimes, losing her temper and casting a Fire Magic Spell on others, especially on Zorran who annoys her and sexualised her for being a good looking woman. Making her very fierce and those who cross her will pay with there life.

she is a bit tomboyish, imposing, sharp-tongued, and extremely blunt, always blurting what she truly thinks and feels like without reservation, even if said comments come at others' expense. She makes it a personal philosophy to always be honest as it feels better.

Relationships with other Main Characters:

(Renzu)---She has a very healthy friendship and respect to Renzu the Main Hero of the Story (Protagonist) after he helped her out for being framed for a crime she did not commit without judging her. Evangaline over time starts to development feelings towards him but still treats him like any other typical Boy as they are the same age and that Evangaline has never spent so much time with a Boy before.

(Zorran)---She doesn't like him all that much for being a drunken, lazy, childish, and perverted older man. When Zorran slaps her bum she sets his hand on fire with a fire magic spell which Zorran never learns from. Evangaline has to keep her guard up around him all the time as Zorran is unpredictable.

(Drako)--She feels Drako's pain after he lost his loved one to a Troll Monster, although Drako hasn't been part of the team for that long and she doe's not know him all too well but she enjoys his fighting spirit and resolve and get's along well with him 2nd to Renzu. Evangaline doe's not get why Drako likes Zorran that much or why his calling him "Master". She thinks he is a bit naïve.

What I'm looking for:

A Female Actress who is Capable, Committed, Not in full Education, Fit for the role, Flexible with her Rota, and is able to travel to Milton Keynes. And can travel to other locations outside Milton Keynes.

Age: 18-24

Height: 5.1 foot to 5.8 foot

Skin: White

Hair Colour: Any.

Body Type: Slim Build, Chubby, Athletic

Acting Requirements: Everybody is welcome, show me what you can do and what you know based on your Acting Experience.

Nationality: White British. Other White or British Nationality are welcome within reason.

I'm willing to let 1 or 2 slide if you don't meet the requirements, the rest will come down to a finale decision as I can't make any mistakes as this role is very important to be filled. If you don't think you can do this or can't handle it then best to step down from applying.

How to apply:

You can send a message to me directly. We can talk first, exchange information and contacts maybe, I will answer some questions that you wish to know or what I have missed in this Casting Call but not too many please as it saves time and I want to save my breath in answering questions and providing more info to those who are actually serious about this Post (No time wasters please).

After a few steps I'LL arrange a time and date to meet face to face with you if you live in or near Milton Keynes or by Video Call if you live far away like London. The chat will be about 1 hour and 30 mins.

If you are traveling to meet me in person your Travel Cost will be covered coming to Milton Keynes and going back home, which I will provide a fair sum for the time you have taken to see me on your journey.

Looking to continue filming with are new Actress as Evangaline ASAP.

Link to my Series on YouTube: https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PL5A8Ih2U1y15yAfFecmlZ4q_QsdmDLCXT&si=zU8XrRNGpXokHSDY

Thank you for taking the time to read this.

🎄 POSZUKUJEMY MODELI I MODELEK DO ŚWIĄTECZNEJ SESJI ZDJĘCIOWEJ! 📸

Do realizacji klimatycznej, świątecznej sesji zdjęciowej poszukujemy osób (najchętniej rodzinki), które chciałyby stanąć przed obiektywem i wspólnie z nami stworzyć trochę świątecznej magii! ✨

🎁 Sesja realizowana jest na zasadzie barteru, czyli w zamian za udział otrzymacie profesjonalne zdjęcia, które będziecie mogli wykorzystać we własnym portfolio lub po prostu zachować na pamiątkę, do prywatnego czy rodzinnego albumu. ❤️

📍 Miejsce: Warszawa centrum 

📅 Termin: jutro, sobota, 24 października 2026 r.

🕚 Godzina: 11:00

Nie wymagamy profesjonalnego doświadczenia przed obiektywem. Zależy nam przede wszystkim na naturalności, swobodzie i dobrej energii!

📩 Jak się zgłosić?

Wyślijcie na adres: Mao16@vp.pl 

•⁠  ⁠kilka aktualnych zdjęć (nie muszą być profesjonalne),

•⁠  ⁠⁠imię,

Zgłaszajcie się jeśli jesteście dyspozycyjni w wybranym terminie ( 24.10.2026 godz. 11:00).

W tytule wiadomości wpiszcie: SESJA ŚWIĄTECZNA 2026.

Zastrzegamy sobie prawo do selekcji zgłoszeń. Odezwiemy się tylko do wybranych osób.

🎄 POSZUKUJEMY MODELI I MODELEK DO ŚWIĄTECZNEJ SESJI ZDJĘCIOWEJ! 📸

Do realizacji klimatycznej, świątecznej sesji zdjęciowej poszukujemy osób (najchętniej rodzinki), które chciałyby stanąć przed obiektywem i wspólnie z nami stworzyć trochę świątecznej magii! ✨

🎁 Sesja realizowana jest na zasadzie barteru, czyli w zamian za udział otrzymacie profesjonalne zdjęcia, które będziecie mogli wykorzystać we własnym portfolio lub po prostu zachować na pamiątkę, do prywatnego czy rodzinnego albumu. ❤️

📍 Miejsce: Warszawa centrum 

📅 Termin: jutro, sobota, 24 października 2026 r.

🕚 Godzina: 11:00

Nie wymagamy profesjonalnego doświadczenia przed obiektywem. Zależy nam przede wszystkim na naturalności, swobodzie i dobrej energii!

📩 Jak się zgłosić?

Wyślijcie na adres: Mao16@vp.pl 

•⁠  ⁠kilka aktualnych zdjęć (nie muszą być profesjonalne),

•⁠  ⁠⁠imię,

Zgłaszajcie się jeśli jesteście dyspozycyjni w wybranym terminie ( 24.10.2026 godz. 11:00).

W tytule wiadomości wpiszcie: SESJA ŚWIĄTECZNA 2026.

Zastrzegamy sobie prawo do selekcji zgłoszeń. Odezwiemy się tylko do wybranych osób.

items.text:
You watch your self-tape back and think: “That’s not what I meant to do.”

You understood the scene. You felt connected to it. But on camera, the performance looks flat, forced or completely different from what you intended.

And when nobody gives you feedback, how are you supposed to know what to change?

In this FREE live Acting Masterclass, Michael Keogh (Peaky Blinders, Casualty, Marvel’s Secret Invasion) will show you what makes a performance connect on camera, why overthinking can flatten a scene, and how to create emotion without forcing it.

Sunday November 1st at 6pm UK time / 1pm ET

Attend live and receive a FREE bonus valued at $97.

RSVP NOW at the following link: 

https://bit.ly/4pCzU5V

#ukactors #laactors #nycactors #britishactors #actingclass

items.text: This one hurts...I first met Eric years ago (Way before Looney Tunes) at one of the big voice over party's at Joe Cipriano's. We hit it off and hung at the same table for quite a while. Affable, funny, crazy talented, he was just getting started and had no idea rhere he was headed. We'd cross paths over the years and it was like no time had transpired. The last time we caught up was at  One Voice Dallas in 2024 and it was a complete honor to be on the Animation panel with him. God bless buddy, Rest In Peace. Heaven is an even better place with you in it

items.text:
# **We are in search of men for an upcoming Dickens themed immersive market we are producing in Central London. **

All our female roles are cast but we're a bit low on men. 

The market involves improv actors playing characters from Dickens novels such as Fagin and Joe Gargery. You'd be interacting with the public as they try to solve a mystery. 

Dates 23-28th November 

Location: Central London (outdoors)

Fee: £1000 all inclusive

If you don't have casting callback please email caspian@unusualservice.co.uk with the subject line ACTOR - Dickens Market 

[https://castingcallback.com/job/25394/dickens-christmas-fair-characters](https://castingcallback.com/job/25394/dickens-christmas-fair-characters)

items.text:
**Kleinwüchsige Darstellerin gesucht für „Getting In", Kunsthalle Wien**

 

Honorar: EUR 700,- (Werkvertrag, inklusive aller Proben und der Aufführung)

Bewerbungsfrist: 23. Oktober 2026, 23:59 Uhr

Aufführung: 17. November 2026, 19:00 Uhr, Kunsthalle Wien Karlsplatz

 

„Getting In" ist ein neues Lustspiel des kanadischen Regisseurs Harkeerat Mangat für eine Darstellerin. Es erzählt die Geschichte von Maria, die von der Pflege ihrer Mutter nach Hause zurückkehrt und feststellt, dass der Zugangscode zu ihrem Wohnhaus geändert wurde. Ausgesperrt muss sie ihre exzentrischen Nachbar*innen davon überzeugen, sie hereinzulassen. Premiere am 17. November 2026 um 19:00 Uhr in der Kunsthalle Wien Karlsplatz.

 

Alle Details: https://kunsthallewien.at/veranstaltung/performance-harkeerat-mangat-getting-in

**Die Rolle: Maria**

 

Wir suchen eine kleinwüchsige Frau, ca. 100 bis 150 cm, ca. 35 bis 65 Jahre, für die Rolle der Maria, die einzige Live-Rolle des Stücks.

 

Das Bühnenbild ist ein Modell-Wohnhaus von drei Metern Höhe, und die Bewohner*innen, die Maria zu überzeugen versucht, sind sehr klein. Die Dimensionen des Stücks funktionieren nur mit einer kleinwüchsigen Darstellerin.

 

Marias Sprache ist für das Publikum nicht verständlich. Der Text muss daher nicht auswendig gelernt werden. Die Bewegungsabläufe müssen einstudiert werden, es gibt darin aber Raum für Improvisation.

 

Da eine erfundene Sprache immer nach jener Sprache klingt, aus der sie kommt, suchen wir jemanden, der österreichisches Deutsch als Muttersprache oder auf muttersprachlichem Niveau spricht. Das Kauderwelsch soll österreichisch klingen.

 

Schauspielerfahrung ist willkommen, aber keine Voraussetzung. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen auf jedem Erfahrungsstand, auch von Personen, die noch nie auf einer Bühne gestanden sind.

 

**Zeitplan**

 

Bewerbungsfrist: 23. Oktober 2026, 23:59 Uhr

Vorsprechen: Woche ab 26. Oktober 2026, via Zoom

Erste Probe: Wochenende 30. Oktober bis 1. November 2026, vor Ort

Zweite Probe: Woche ab 9. November 2026

Endprobe auf der Bühne: 17. November 2026, Kunsthalle Wien Karlsplatz

Aufführung: 17. November 2026, 19:00 Uhr

 

Stundenausmaß: drei Proben à maximal vier Stunden sowie die Aufführung, gesamt ca. 14 Stunden.

** **

**Engagement und Honorar**

 

EUR 700,- gesamt auf Werkvertragsbasis, inklusive aller Proben und der Aufführung. Das Honorar orientiert sich an der Honoraruntergrenze der IG Freie Theaterarbeit. Auftraggeber: Harkeerat Mangat.

 

**Bewerbung**

 

Bitte schick bis 23. Oktober 2026 eine E-Mail an casting@harkeeratmangat.com mit:

 

1. Einem Foto von dir. Ein Handyfoto genügt völlig, es muss kein professionelles Foto sein.

2. Deinem Namen, Alter und deiner Körpergröße.

3. Ob du schon einmal gespielt hast, und wenn ja, kurz was. „Keine Erfahrung" ist eine völlig gute Antwort.

4. Ob du österreichisches Deutsch sprichst und ob es deine Alltagssprache ist.

 

Mehr braucht es nicht. Kein Lebenslauf, kein Showreel und kein Motivationsschreiben.

 

**Über den Künstler **

 

Harkeerat Mangat (geb. 1990 in Vancouver) ist kanadischer Filmemacher und Theaterregisseur und lebt in Wien. Sein Film „Fürstenplatz" und sein großangelegtes Theaterprojekt „Sommer-Kultur-Fest" wurden mit dem Vordemberge-Gildewart-Preis ausgezeichnet. Einzelausstellungen hatte er im Bonner Kunstverein, in der Stiftung Museum Insel Hombroich und im kjubh Kunstverein; Performances zeigte er im Kunstverein Gartenhaus, Wien, und in der Zweigstelle Capitain, Neapel.

 

Er entwirft Szenarien, innerhalb derer die Darsteller*innen frei improvisieren, und arbeitet sowohl mit professionellen als auch mit nicht-professionellen Schauspieler*innen.

 

KONTAKT

 

Harkeerat Mangat

casting@harkeeratmangat.com

Ausgesperrt muss sie ihre exzentrischen Nachbar*innen davon überzeugen, sie hereinzulassen. Premiere am 17. November 2026 um 19:00 Uhr in der Kunsthalle Wien Karlsplatz.

 

Alle Details: https://kunsthallewien.at/veranstaltung/performance-harkeerat-mangat-getting-in

**Die Rolle: Maria**

 

Wir suchen eine kleinwüchsige Frau, ca. 100 bis 150 cm, ca. 35 bis 65 Jahre, für die Rolle der Maria, die einzige Live-Rolle des Stücks.

 

Das Bühnenbild ist ein Modell-Wohnhaus von drei Metern Höhe, und die Bewohner*innen, die Maria zu überzeugen versucht, sind sehr klein. Die Dimensionen des Stücks funktionieren nur mit einer kleinwüchsigen Darstellerin.

 

Marias Sprache ist für das Publikum nicht verständlich. Der Text muss daher nicht auswendig gelernt werden. Die Bewegungsabläufe müssen einstudiert werden, es gibt darin aber Raum für Improvisation.

 

Da eine erfundene Sprache immer nach jener Sprache klingt, aus der sie kommt, suchen wir jemanden, der österreichisches Deutsch als Muttersprache oder auf muttersprachlichem Niveau spricht. Das Kauderwelsch soll österreichisch klingen.

 

Schauspielerfahrung ist willkommen, aber keine Voraussetzung. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen auf jedem Erfahrungsstand, auch von Personen, die noch nie auf einer Bühne gestanden sind.

 

**Zeitplan**

 

Bewerbungsfrist: 23. Oktober 2026, 23:59 Uhr

Vorsprechen: Woche ab 26. Oktober 2026, via Zoom

Erste Probe: Wochenende 30. Oktober bis 1. November 2026, vor Ort

Zweite Probe: Woche ab 9. November 2026

Endprobe auf der Bühne: 17. November 2026, Kunsthalle Wien Karlsplatz

Aufführung: 17. November 2026, 19:00 Uhr

 

Stundenausmaß: drei Proben à maximal vier Stunden sowie die Aufführung, gesamt ca. 14 Stunden.

** **

**Engagement und Honorar**

 

EUR 700,- gesamt auf Werkvertragsbasis, inklusive aller Proben und der Aufführung. Das Honorar orientiert sich an der Honoraruntergrenze der IG Freie Theaterarbeit. Auftraggeber: Harkeerat Mangat.

 

**Bewerbung**

 

Bitte schick bis 23. Oktober 2026 eine E-Mail an casting@harkeeratmangat.com mit:

 

1. Einem Foto von dir. Ein Handyfoto genügt völlig, es muss kein professionelles Foto sein.

2. Deinem Namen, Alter und deiner Körpergröße.

3. Ob du schon einmal gespielt hast, und wenn ja, kurz was. „Keine Erfahrung" ist eine völlig gute Antwort.

4. Ob du österreichisches Deutsch sprichst und ob es deine Alltagssprache ist.

 

Mehr braucht es nicht. Kein Lebenslauf, kein Showreel und kein Motivationsschreiben.

 

**Über den Künstler **

 

Harkeerat Mangat (geb. 1990 in Vancouver) ist kanadischer Filmemacher und Theaterregisseur und lebt in Wien. Sein Film „Fürstenplatz" und sein großangelegtes Theaterprojekt „Sommer-Kultur-Fest" wurden mit dem Vordemberge-Gildewart-Preis ausgezeichnet. Einzelausstellungen hatte er im Bonner Kunstverein, in der Stiftung Museum Insel Hombroich und im kjubh Kunstverein; Performances zeigte er im Kunstverein Gartenhaus, Wien, und in der Zweigstelle Capitain, Neapel.

 

Er entwirft Szenarien, innerhalb derer die Darsteller*innen frei improvisieren, und arbeitet sowohl mit professionellen als auch mit nicht-professionellen Schauspieler*innen.

 

KONTAKT

 

Harkeerat Mangat

casting@harkeeratmangat.com

Brand Representatives Wanted – Liverpool ☕
The £1 Coffee Network | 4-Week Campaign

Staff Playbook is recruiting confident, outgoing and personable Brand Representatives to join an exciting new campaign promoting The £1 Coffee Network across Liverpool.

The campaign aims to bring more cafés, coffee shops and restaurants into the network, giving eligible customers with a Klarna account the opportunity to enjoy a barista-made coffee for just £1 at participating venues.

Your role will be to visit local cafés and restaurants, introduce the promotion to owners and managers, explain the benefits of getting involved, and help businesses sign up to the network.

📍 Campaign Details

* Location: Liverpool – field-based
* Campaign dates: Monday 2nd November – Saturday 28th November 2026
* Working pattern: 5 days per week, which may include one Saturday
* Hours: 9:00am–5:00pm
* Pay: £600 per week
* Travel allowance: £55 per week
* Mandatory training: Friday 30th October at 3:00pm

☕ Your Responsibilities

* Visit independent cafés, coffee shops and restaurants across Liverpool.
* Introduce The £1 Coffee Network and explain the promotional opportunity.
* Engage with business owners and managers to encourage participation.
* Support interested venues through the sign-up process.
* Build positive relationships with local hospitality businesses.
* Record visits, track sign-ups and provide regular campaign updates.
* Represent the campaign professionally and enthusiastically.

👋 Who We’re Looking For

* Friendly, confident and approachable individuals.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Comfortable approaching new businesses and speaking with decision-makers.
* Previous experience in field sales, business development, promotional work or customer-facing roles is desirable.
* Self-motivated, organised and able to work independently.
* Must hold a full UK driving licence and have access to a car, as the role involves travelling between venues across Liverpool.
* Available for the full four-week campaign and mandatory training.

📩 How to Apply

Interested in joining the campaign?

Please send your CV and details of your relevant experience to hello@staffplaybook.co.uk.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Hello everyone! We’re casting David and Bridget for our upcoming short film ***Boarding Home***. (ONLY LOCAL TALENT WILL BE ACCEPTED)

**Logline:** When a hopeful young woman arrives at a boarding home to visit a friend, her attempts to help the people living there catch the attention of a quiet, dejected mechanic who starts questioning why she’s really there.

We’re looking for actors who connect with the characters and are looking for something interesting to play. If David or Bridget catches your attention, we’d love to see your audition.

**Casting Details:**
**Non-Union | Unpaid | Meals Provided on Set | IMDb Credit | Professional Reel Footage**
**Shooting Date:** Saturday, November 7, 2026
**Audition Dates:** October 25–29

**Shooting Location:** Toronto, Ontario, Canada

**Interested?** Please send your headshot, resume, and demo reel to jonosei@horizondreamproductions.ca.

items.text:
Hello, everyone! I’m casting for a surreal indie feature with an “early-cinema” look, with painted faces and vaudevillian/storybookish costumes…the material at turns dark, silly, poetic, musical…basically, “art film”! To get a sense of the style, you can see my work on YouTube at Candy Town Follies, and on TikTok at Candy Town Scandals.

[https://www.youtube.com/@candytownfollies](https://www.youtube.com/@candytownfollies)

https://www.tiktok.com/@mrdobbs

We're looking to cast a Caucasian boy, between the age of 10 and 13, to play the male lead. We’ll be shooting through to the middle of next year, in Chicago and in Elgin Illinois, with plans to get it out to the film festival circuit by the end of the year. Unfortunately, there’s no pay, as what budget we have will have to be spent on production…but we do feed everyone at the shoots, the film will be listed on IMDB, and all the actors sign contracts which entitle them to a share of the proceeds, if the movie were to make money.

If you’re a stage parent, have a son about that age, and might be interested…please contact me here or at ctfollies@gmail.com …or if you KNOW a stage parent with a son this age, please please please pass this along! Thanks so much!

Authentische Schauspieler gesucht – Raum Frankfurt – faire Bezahlung 💚
Wir sind Glücks Krone – eine der am schnellsten wachsenden Gesundheitsmarken in Deutschland. Und wir fangen gerade erst an. 🚀

Für unsere Werbeanzeigen suchen wir Schauspielerinnen und Schauspieler, die nicht wie Schauspieler wirken. Echte Energie. Kein TV-Spot-Feeling.

Drehtage ca. 3–4 Stunden. Faire Vergütung. Wenn die Chemie stimmt, arbeiten wir langfristig zusammen.

Bewerbung dauert unter 5 Minuten 👉 https://form.typeform.com/to/ITfZoBXH
